nodes.name: Secrets is available in early access. It is a separate…
nodes.text: Secrets is available in early access. It is a separate library in Memory for environment sets, login credentials and private files, with its own grants for each secret.

nodes.name: - Grants per secret for seeing it, reading or exporting…
nodes.text:
- Grants per secret for seeing it, reading or exporting its value, writing new versions and managing access. Ordinary Memory access never grants any of them.
- Encryption at rest with a fresh key for every version. This protects stored data, not authorized readers or exported copies.
- Values that stay hidden until revealed, and clear again after 60 seconds.
- Optional review: request review for a replacement and another member with read and write access approves it.
- Tags and short summaries suggested from a secret’s name and type only, never from its value.

nodes.name: Agent connections need a separate Secrets capability, off…
nodes.text: Agent connections need a separate Secrets capability, off by default. The client can import a secret from a local file and export one to a new owner-only file, so values don’t need to pass through the conversation. The in-app agent, Null, has no Secrets tools.
